annotator: assistant (Claude), 2026-11-17 — NOT a human annotation; categories from EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md §8 plus 'unclear'; based only on the claim, the best retrieved passage (first 380 chars) and the judge label shown by scripts/show_failure_sample.py; must be checked by a human before any number from it is reported as a hand categorisation

codes.JE: judge error — claim is supported by the retrieved Wikipedia text (often a different page than the judge's evidence: FActScore uses only the topic's page, ASQA uses the oracle documents), judge says unsupported
codes.RM: retrieval miss — wrong entity retrieved (name collision), evidence not retrieved, or misleading/imprecise source passage
codes.VFP: verifier false positive — passage does not support the claim but s is high
codes.VFN: verifier false negative — passage supports the claim but s is below the conformal threshold (0.98 bio / 0.974 ASQA)
codes.DE: decomposition error — claim is a hedge, fragment or truncated list item
